ModMetaData.name: Ordered Work (Core)
ModMetaData.author: nightmare123487
ModMetaData.description: Ordered Work (0.3.0-alpha.322). Profile-backed WorkType and WorkGiver ordering, a Split/Merge/Order editor with Action word metadata and two-step Revert/Delete, per-pawn Work Control, schedule presets, hourly focus and zone policy. Changes are written to profile JSON; restart remains the safe boundary for generated definitions. Do not use in a main save; back up your save first.
